#### 1. familial cavitary optic disk anomaly  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.411)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-1474228)

**Proposed mechanism:** CDH1 (HGNC:2094) —DISRUPTS→ Cell adhesion (GO:0007155); Cell adhesion (GO:0007155) —LEADS_TO→ Epithelial-mesenchymal transition (GO:0001837); Epithelial-mesenchymal transition (GO:0001837) —LEADS_TO→ Extracellular matrix organization (GO:0030198); CDH1 (HGNC:2094) —LEADS_TO→ Hereditary diffuse gastric adenocarcinoma (MONDO:0007648); MMP19 (HGNC:7507) —DISRUPTS→ Extracellular matrix organization (GO:0030198); Extracellular matrix organization (GO:0030198) —LEADS_TO→ Familial cavitary optic disk anomaly (MONDO:0012687); MMP19 (HGNC:7507) —LEADS_TO→ Familial cavitary optic disk anomaly (MONDO:0012687). Loss of function in CDH1 disrupts cell adhesion, promoting epithelial-mesenchymal transition and ultimately affecting extracellular matrix organization, leading to hereditary diffuse gastric adenocarcinoma. Concurrently, loss of function in MMP19 directly disrupts extracellular matrix organization, contributing to familial cavitary optic disk anomaly. The convergence is on the shared pathway of extracellular matrix organization.

**How to falsify it:** If genetic studies reveal that mutations in CDH1 do not lead to loss-of-function phenotypes impacting cell adhesion or EMT, or if mutations in MMP19 do not affect extracellular matrix organization, this hypothesis would be falsified. Additionally, if common variants in CDH1 or MMP19 are found at a high frequency (>1%) in gnomAD within populations relevant to these rare diseases, it would challenge their primary causal role. _(variant: rs112653567 (CDH1 c.1639G>A, p.Glu547Lys) or other known pathogenic variants in CDH1/MMP19 with high allele frequency)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role in extracellular matrix regulation could suggest therapeutic strategies targeting matrix remodeling pathways for both gastric cancer progression and optic nerve anomalies. For instance, modulating MMP activity or ECM composition might offer avenues for treatment.
